message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large white capital letters. Below it, several caricatured men are depicted in a group. In the foreground, two men in grey shirts apply green face paint to their cheeks with their fingers. One man on the left has one diagonal stripe, while the man on the right has three horizontal stripes. Surrounding them are four other men in neutral-toned shirts, positioned in the middle ground. Their expressions vary from neutral to smiling. Some of these men appear older, with grey hair and facial wrinkles.

Centrally placed white text reads "PAMER PAMOR SERDADU TUA" followed by smaller text: "Calon presiden 2024 berlomba merangkul pensiunan jenderal TNI-Polri. Mengharap efek elektoral. H.26". At the top, two smaller headlines state: "Jejaring Narkotik Fredy Pratama H.64" and "Karpet Merah Satelit Elon Musk H.74". The upper right corner includes "25 SEPTEMBER-1 OKTOBER 2023", "RP 50.000", "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO", and a barcode with a QR code. The background is a solid, dark olive green. All figures and text are rendered in a clean, outlined illustrative style.
